text:
Marta: Quick Friday question — imagine your home becomes a one-night-only restaurant. What's your signature dish and why? I'll take orders ;)
Jon: Beef bourguignon, weekend reheat = perfection. Also accepting reservations.
Aisha: Vegetarian ramen with a rich miso broth, soft egg, and charred corn. Cozy and underrated.
Devin: Breakfast all day: shakshuka with blistered tomatoes, feta, and crusty bread. Nap-inducing.
Sam: Quinoa-crusted salmon with lemon-butter, roasted asparagus, plus sticky toffee pudding for dessert.
Olivia: @Aisha I want a bowl rn. When's service? :drooling_face:
Maya: Pop-up concept: "Microwave Gourmet" — frozen pierogis plated on vintage china. Very ironic. :laughing:
Kevin: I'd serve my grandma's Peranakan curry. Secret spice paste, serious comfort food. Reservations only.
bot-kudos: :tada: Kevin's message got a :tada: reaction
Jules: Also need a playlist. My setlist: bossa nova -> indie folk -> lo-fi. Mood lighting provided.
Avery: Can backyard kitchens pass health code? Asking for a friend. :stuck_out_tongue:
Marta: BYO-fire-extinguisher policy and all disclaimers in small print.
Riya: Menu would be tight: three mains, two sides, one dessert. Pop-up price: $35.
Jon: Table for one, Tuesday at 8pm, bringing excessive napkins.
Maya: I'll bring the vintage china and a cheffy apron. Dress code: comfy.
Aisha: Who does dish duty if this goes IRL? :raised_hand:
Sam: I'll cook if someone else does dishes. Trade offer.
Devin: Deal. Mostly here for the shakshuka.
Marta: Poll time: who's in? Drop a :raised_hand: or :no_entry_sign:
Olivia: :raised_hand:
Kevin: :raised_hand:
Jules: :no_entry_sign: (date night this week)
Riya: :raised_hand:

Marta: Nice. I'll pick a date and send a tiny RSVP form. Bonus points for themed napkins.
Kevin: I own a set of flamingo napkins.
Marta: Flamingo napkins = official theme. See you all (maybe) at the pop-up!
